blocks.tamil_translation: he will not be able to enter Jannah with the Muslims,” Hazrat Ma'qil ibn Yasar (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا مِنْ وَالٍ يَلِي رَعِيَّةً مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَيَمُوتُ وَهُوَ غَاشٌّ لَهُمْ إِلَّا حَرَّمَ اللهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب من استرعي رعية فلم ينصح، رقم:٧١٥١
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever is appointed in charge of the Muslims and then dies while in a state of deceiving them, Allah Ta'ala will make Jannah haram for him,” Hazrat Ma'qil ibn Yasar (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ اْلاَزْدِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ وَلَّاهُ اللهُ شَيْئاً مِنْ أَمْرِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَاحْتَجَبَ دُونَ حَاجَتِهِمْ وَخَلَّتِهِمْ وَفَقْرِهِمُ احْتَجَبَ اللهُ عَنْهُ دُونَ حَاجَتِهِ وَخَلَّتِهِ وَفَقْرِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد، باب فيما يلزم الامام من امر الرعية....، رقم:٢٩٤٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “If Allah Ta'ala makes anyone responsible for the affairs of the Muslims, and he pays no attention to the difficulties and needs of the Muslims and their poverty (not fulfilling their needs and not striving to remove their poverty), then on the Day of Qiyamah Allah Ta'ala too will turn His face away from his difficulty, need and poverty” (on the Day of Qiyamah He will not remove his needs and difficulties), Hazrat Abu Maryam Azdi (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ
